Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 8

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Judy Berlin has the older director. The task was to determine which film has the director who is older, not which film has the younger director. The Planner correctly identified the birth years of the directors: Eric Mendelsohn (1964) for Judy Berlin and Harry A. Pollard (1879) for Tonight At Twelve. However, the final conclusion mistakenly stated that Judy Berlin has the older director, when in fact, Harry A. Pollard (born in 1879) is older than Eric Mendelsohn (born in 1964). Therefore, Tonight At Twelve should have been identified as having the older director.
